summary.text: Joe Hohenstein, listed by Ballotpedia as Joseph Hohenstein, is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 177 since December 1, 2018 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Hohenstein earned a bachelor's degree from Earlham College in 1989 and a J.D. from the University of Minnesota in 1993.
His professional experience includes working as an immigration attorney, in nonprofit organizations and in private practice, and he taught at Temple University's Beasley School of Law.
He was clerk (chair) of the Board of Frankford Friends School and served on the National Amicus Committee of the American Immigration Lawyers Association.
Hohenstein succeeded Republican John Taylor in the seat in December 2018.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Environmental Resources and Energy, Game and Fisheries, Judiciary and Transportation committees.
